strategy.summary: The todo app (public/app.js, purely client-side, in-memory state) lets users tick todos complete, filter All/Active/Completed with aria-pressed state, and clear completed todos. Playwright e2e tests against the real static server must prove strike-through and count changes on tick/untick, each filter's contents and pressed state, and that "Clear completed" appears only while something is completed and removes every completed todo.
inScope: Completing/uncompleting via checkbox: strike-through and items-left count
All/Active/Completed filters: visible items and aria-pressed
outOfScope: Adding todos (covered by tests/add-todo.spec.js, TODO earlier ticket)
Persistence across reloads (app keeps state in memory only; ticket doesn't ask)
assumptions: The real server (node server.js) runs via the existing playwright.config.js webServer; nothing is faked — there is no backend API, state lives in the page.
Each test gets a fresh page, so todos never leak between tests; todos are created through the UI in each test.
'Struck through' is verified as computed CSS text-decoration-line: line-through on the todo's text, since that is how styles.css renders completion.
'Shown as pressed' means aria-pressed="true" on the selected filter button and "false" on the others.
openQuestions: Should ticking a todo while the Active filter is selected immediately hide it? The code does re-render, but the ticket doesn't say; not tested.

risks.description: Count text or strike-through not updating on untick
Clear completed removing active todos or only some completed ones
risks.mitigation: TC7 uses two completed and one active todo and asserts the exact remaining list

risks.description: Filter shows wrong set or pressed state stale
risks.mitigation: TC3-5 assert exact lists and aria-pressed on all three buttons

acceptanceCriteria.text: Ticking a todo's checkbox strikes it through and decrements the items-left count by one; unticking reverses both.
Active shows only uncompleted todos, Completed only completed ones, All every todo; the selected filter button is aria-pressed=true.
"Clear completed" is visible only while at least one todo is completed, and clicking it removes every completed todo.

testCases.title: ticking a todo strikes it through and decrements the items left
steps: Assert '2 items left' and no strike-through
testCases.expected: 'Buy milk' checkbox checked, its text has line-through, 'Walk dog' not struck, count reads '1 item left'

testCases.title: unticking a completed todo removes the strike-through and restores the items left
steps: Add two todos, tick one, assert '1 item left'
testCases.expected: Checkbox unchecked, text-decoration-line none, '2 items left'

testCases.title: Active filter shows only uncompleted todos and is pressed
steps: Add three todos, tick the second
testCases.expected: List is exactly the first and third todos; Active aria-pressed=true, All and Completed false

testCases.title: Completed filter shows only completed todos and is pressed
steps: Add three todos, tick the second
testCases.expected: List is exactly the second todo; Completed aria-pressed=true, others false

testCases.title: All filter shows every todo again and is pressed
steps: Add three todos, tick the second
testCases.expected: List is all three todos in order; All aria-pressed=true, others false

testCases.title: Clear completed is hidden while no todo is completed
steps: Add a todo, assert it is listed
testCases.expected: Button hidden before ticking, visible while ticked, hidden again after unticking
testCases.rationale: Refusal side: the action isn't offered without completed todos

testCases.title: Clear completed removes every completed todo and keeps active ones
steps: Add three todos, tick the first and third
testCases.expected: List is exactly the second todo, '1 item left', Clear completed hidden
testCases.rationale: Removes all, not just one, and never active ones

strategy.environmentNotes: Playwright's webServer starts `node server.js` on port 4173 (BASE_URL). No backend data; browsers must be installed.
